points.point: On November 19, 2026, Intuit agreed to sell its Mailchimp business to Bending Spoons for approximately $3.68 billion in cash and common stock.
points.quote: On November 19, 2026, Intuit entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Mailchimp business to Bending Spoons S.p.A. (Bending Spoons) for total consideration valued at approximately $ 3.68 billion, consisting of approximately $ 3.31 billion in cash and $ 368 million in Bending Spoons common stock, subject to customary closing adjustments.

points.point: Two purported shareholder class actions were filed against Intuit and certain executives in July and August 2026 alleging false and misleading statements.
points.quote: On July 10, 2026 and August 17, 2026, two purported shareholder class actions were filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California against the Company and certain members of management.

points.point: Intuit is unable to estimate a reasonably possible financial loss or range of loss to resolve outstanding legal proceedings and regulatory inquiries.
points.quote: In view of the complexity and ongoing and uncertain nature of the outstanding proceedings and inquiries, at this time, we are unable to estimate a reasonably possible financial loss or range of financial loss that we may incur to resolve or settle these matters.
